on-accent.note: Foreground for text/icons on a solid --accent fill. Inverts between modes (#FFFFFF light, #1A1A1A dark) because --accent itself lightens in dark mode: white is 4.82:1 on light-mode terracotta but 3.41:1 on the dark-mode value, and near-black is the reverse. No single value clears AA in both.

display.purpose: Hero and section-level headlines only. True italics available and used for the mixed roman/italic headline treatment.

body.purpose: All reading copy and interface text.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, field labels, nav, badges, numeric/stat values. Never body copy.

shadows.name: neu-raised
shadows.purpose: Buttons, inputs (base layer), stat cards. Parchment-toned shadow pair, not black/white.

shadows.name: glass-flat
shadows.purpose: Panel separation only — sidebar, modals, feature cards. Always paired with a hairline border and 20px backdrop blur.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Accent-colored focus ring, layered over the element's base shadow.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Page and section entrance animation (staggered headings, hero reveal) via the motion/react library.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Terracotta fill with the adaptive on-accent foreground.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 28px; background-color: var(--accent, #B05A36); color: var(--on-accent, #FFFFFF); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 12px #E6DDCD, -6px -6px 12px #FFFDF7; transition: transform 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 4px 4px 8px #E6DDCD, -4px -4px 8px #FFFDF7; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), inset -1px -1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent, hairline-bordered, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 28px; background-color: transparent; color: #2A2B2F; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(42,43,47,0.2); border-radius: 9999px; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #515151; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Neumorphic inset text input. Focus border and glow both key off the terracotta token.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background-color: #FEF9EF; color: #2A2B2F; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #E6DDCD, inset -4px -4px 8px #FFFDF7; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #515151; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #B05A36); box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 8px #E6DDCD, inset -4px -4px 8px #FFFDF7, 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #B05A36) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Fragrance Card
components.description: Signature browse/catalogue tile. Tonal elevation (no shadow) despite the neumorphic class name — a hairline border and one-tone-deeper background carry the depth instead.
components.html:
Maison

Example Fragrance
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #F5EEE1; border: 1px solid #D1C9BF; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(176,90,54,0.30); } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio: 1; background: rgba(230,221,205,0.3); } .ds-card-body { padding: 12px; } .ds-card-brand { font-size: 12px; color: #515151; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #2A2B2F; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status pill. Active variant is a terracotta tint with a terracotta-edge border.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #D1C9BF; background-color: rgba(245,238,225,0.72); color: #515151; } .ds-badge-active { background-color: var(--accent-dim, rgba(176,90,54,0.10)); border-color: var(--accent-edge, rgba(176,90,54,0.30)); color: var(--accent, #B05A36); }

narrative.overview: Parfum de Climat reads like a bound record kept by someone who takes scent seriously: parchment pages, a terracotta wax seal standing in for the one accent that matters, and a warm, ink-on-paper voice throughout. Nothing about it should feel like a SaaS dashboard wearing perfume branding — it should feel like the tool a perfumer's assistant would actually keep, blending an apothecary's material warmth with the precision of a scoring instrument. The system runs two elevation languages deliberately, never mixed on one element: neumorphism for things you press or fill in, and liquid glass for things you sit inside. Type carries the same split: an editorial serif (Zodiak) for display moments, a warm humanist sans (Satoshi) for reading, and a tracked uppercase monospace for labels and numeric stats.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment-and-terracotta palette; warm in both light and dark mode
Neumorphism for things you act on, liquid glass for things you sit inside — never combined
Pill-shaped interactive elements, 24px-radius containers, no sharp corners
Zodiak (display serif) / Satoshi (body sans) / tracked uppercase monospace (labels) — a three-role type system
Tactile, confident interaction: buttons and inputs read as physically pressable, not flat

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only accent in the system. A legacy wheat gold (#C4A882) previously survived as a hardcoded literal in ten places; all ten now route through the adaptive token. Never reintroduce a raw accent hex — it cannot flip for dark mode, which is exactly how the drift started.

rules.name: The No-Inter Rule
rules.body: Inter never renders as the body face; it is a fallback three deep only.

rules.name: The Never-Both Rule
rules.body: Neumorphism and Liquid Glass never coexist on one element. Stated explicitly in the source; the system's central material law.

dos: Do use terracotta for any new accent, link, or active-state need.
Do use pill radius on every new interactive control; 20–32px radius on containers.
Do reserve the uppercase tracked monospace role for labels, eyebrows, and numeric stats only.
Do keep dark-mode neutrals warm; never desaturate toward cool grey or true black.
Do treat neumorphism and liquid glass as mutually exclusive per element.
donts: Don't combine neumorphic shadows and glass blur/translucency on the same element.
Don't introduce a hardcoded accent hex anywhere, in CSS or JS config. Route through var(--accent), or color-mix() off it for tints.
Don't put var(--ink) on a solid accent fill. Use var(--on-accent), which inverts independently.
Don't use Inter as the body face; it is a fallback only.
Don't use sharp (0px) corners on any interactive element.
